output.summary: Turnover rise is real (payroll-reconciled), so the HRIS artifact claim fails. It exceeds the peer rise (33 to 38 versus 28 to 47), so labor-market tightening alone does not explain it. Monthly separations were already elevated before ShiftWise (Oct-Feb 11 per month versus 7.2) and stepped up in March, when the all-branch Saturday policy started. Schedule complaints are not concentrated at ShiftWise branches. Pay, manager and ShiftWise causes cannot be separated without branch-level data and a current market benchmark. The manager-of-record field is stale, so A2 would punish the wrong people. Do the branch and ShiftWise analysis and the pay benchmark first. Hold the irreversible 15 percent raise. A targeted adjustment is still possible by 2027-01-05.
